claims.value: IgG control (no bait) rows 1-3; USP39 rows 4-6; PRPF4 rows 7-12
claims.evidence: USP39 arm: mqpar.xml maps Igg_unt_01-03 to experiments IGG1-3 and USP10_unt_01-03 to USP391-3; USP39-interactome-HELA.xlsx: USP39 log2 LFQ 20.9-22.1 in IGG vs 29.7-29.8 in USP39 (difference 8.43, top hit), while USP10 is flat (difference -0.23) and its partner G3BP1 is flat (0.33): the bait is USP39, not USP10 as the file names say. PRPF4 arm: file names P4_si39 / PC_c, mqpar experiments p4si39 / p4, table name PRPF4-interactome.xlsx, PRPF4 log2 LFQ ~28.1-28.3 in all six IPs (bait level). There is no IgG control in the PRPF4 arm.

USP39 arm files carry "unt" (untreated). PRPF4 arm: si39 files (mqpar experiment p4si39, Perseus group p4si39) are USP39 siRNA knockdown; PC_c files (mqpar p4, group P4) are the control. Whether the control cells received a non-targeting siRNA is not documented anywhere reachable; `untreated` follows campaign rule 4 (controls = untreated) and means "no USP39 siRNA". OLS has no term for either value (validator warning).

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: only the 12 label-free IP raws are annotated. The 18 SILAC diGly raws (20221231_SFB1_PBE_TM_siUSP39_SILAC_exp{1,2,3}_{1..6}.raw) are blocked: no reachable source states which SILAC channel (light vs Arg10/Lys8 heavy) carries siUSP39 vs control, in any of the three experiments (exp3 is label-swapped in MaxQuant). See annotations/BLOCKED.md section PXD041509.

PARTIAL SCOPE: the 24 TMTpro raws (20220830_LU_LC2_RR_CPG_USP39_PROTAC_F1..F24.raw) are blocked: the deposited .pdStudy has 6 channels (126, 127N, 127C, 128N, 128C, 129N) named only "<file> - [channel]" with no factors; no condition names anywhere. Also searched with Sequest HT and a different modification set (rule 5) - would need its own SDRF.

The publication (Science 2024, doi:10.1126/science.adi5295) is closed access; publisher pages and supplement return HTTP 403 (not bypassed). No preprint was found in Europe PMC. Every value here comes from PRIDE, the deposited search/result files, raw headers and Cellosaurus.

USP39 IP raw files are named "USP10" (20201116_MHO_CP_HeLa_USP10_unt_*). The bait is annotated as USP39 from the MaxQuant experiment names (USP391-3), the deposited table name USP39-interactome-HELA.xlsx and the data (USP39 +8.4 log2 over IgG; USP10 -0.2). A file-naming error is the most likely explanation; it is not confirmed by the authors.

Control of the PRPF4 arm (PC_c, MaxQuant p4): whether it received a non-targeting siRNA is undocumented; it is written `untreated` (rule 4). The USP39 knockdown itself cannot be checked in the deposited table (USP39 absent from the filtered PRPF4-interactome.xlsx).
IP protocol (antibodies, beads, digestion) is not deposited; cleavage agent is taken from the MaxQuant enzyme rule (Trypsin/P -> Trypsin).
PRIDE diseases/sampleAttributes give "malignant neoplasm of ovary" (DOID:2144); this is wrong for HeLa and was replaced by the Cellosaurus disease.
Biological vs technical nature of the three IPs per group is not described; they are numbered as biological replicates 1-3 as MaxQuant/Perseus treats them as independent replicates.
